raw:
I chose single-edit experiments in matched sets. Within a set, the same edit is applied to parents that differ in only one parent edge, so any change in the edit's effect can be attributed to that edge. The edits cover the edges that matter most: the edge-3 skip, the edge-5 conv and pool, the edge-0 and edge-1 convs and removals, and the edge-2 none and skip. Parent edges vary across none, skip, conv and pool. This tests connectivity effects, such as whether another path into node 3 already exists, and the effect of what the edit replaces.
